predictions.claim: O4 (PAR-totality): L_par_tot_batch_RetrieveBlobBytes, forall b: Blob. ok_batch_RetrieveBlobBytes(b) == true, derived over gen/M3/goops/blob_ops.json, is REFUTED by holon run at the real size: its witness is the 4096-cell sequence whose cell 3968 is 1 and every other cell 0 (the first field element whose index i*32 runs off the 126976-byte output), the counter-law accepted by bend, its record's kernel verdict checked by BendTT, with no reduced N, its difference false against true; holon replay-go's side passes: on the blob whose byte 126976 is 1 and every other byte 0, morph-l2/common/batch.RetrieveBlobBytes panics with a runtime index error at data[126976] (length 126976). Recorded, not counted (thresholds.disclosure): a draft model's counter-law of this shape, at the 3969-cell sequence of 3968 zeros and then a 1, checked in both kernels on the draft branch claude/ci-i67-wip (I67-R4), and the smoke run on this key's base observed the record, its kernel verdict and the replay as claimed here.

PAR-weak over the clone pair (the E6 atom of their shared name tokens): L_par_weak_batch_RetrieveBlobBytes_blob_RetrieveBlobBytes is REFUTED at the same witness, its difference OPanic against OErr, its kernel verdict checked; holon replay-go's side passes: the batch clone panics and the blob clone returns a non-nil error. Recorded, not counted (thresholds.disclosure): the smoke run on this key's base observed the record, its kernel verdict and the replay as claimed here.

PAR domain coherence over the interface carrier Blob: L_par_dom_ok_batch_RetrieveBlobBytes_ok_blob_RetrieveBlobBytes is REFUTED at the same witness, its difference false against true, its kernel verdict checked; replayed as I67-P2. Recorded, not counted (thresholds.disclosure): the smoke run on this key's base observed the record, its kernel verdict and the replay as claimed here.

The fixed copy: L_par_tot_blob_RetrieveBlobBytes is UNKNOWN. No candidate refutes it (its model has no panic path), and a forall law over cell sequences has no proof route here (gap G6); its record's bound names the candidates and G6, and no law file is kept. The instrument sees the real blob clone panic on none of its 4101 probes. Recorded, not counted (thresholds.disclosure): the draft model's counter-law for the blob clone failed at the all-zero 4096-cell sequence on the draft branch claude/ci-i67-wip (I67-R4), and the smoke run on this key's base observed the record as claimed here.

(1) On the draft branch claude/ci-i67-wip, 2026-10-23: 3f17e71 and f87fdaa ran the opt-in frontend on common/batch and common/blob (I67-R4 a); 959ef04's draft model checked the batch clone's counter-law {ok(W) == False} in bend and BendTT --verdict at W the 3969-cell sequence of 3968 zeros and then a 1, and the blob clone's counter-law failed at the all-zero 4096-cell sequence (I67-R4 b). (2) The prereg review ran I67-P5's derivation (holon.rules.par.derive_document on the Y4 diagram; its verified[2]). (3) After the review was folded (2026-10-24, 13:37-13:44 UTC), the build code was smoke-run on this key's base 089b43a4 in a scratch worktree, 13:50-13:58: holon extract go, codecs, diagram, evidence, derive and lossy for M3, holon run on the four laws alone, holon replay-go and this key's contract tests (holon bind was started too). It observed every prediction's outcome as predicted: the four laws and statements of I67-P5; I67-P1-P3 REFUTED at cell 3968 = 1 with kernel verdict checked and their replays passed; I67-P4 UNKNOWN with its bound. It also found two contract gaps, both closed before this commit: test_y1_loop_bodies_shape required an error class on a return from a function without an error result, where the paths section writes null (Y1 now says so, and the test was narrowed at 13:58, after it failed); and Y9's stamp must write witness_provenance for Y8 to hold in Y11's order (Y9 and Y11 now say so). The smoke run's code and outputs are backed up, never to be merged, at 42c54af on claude/ci-i67-build-wip, as the draft build's are at ad274fe; neither commit enters the lead's history. So no prediction of this key is counted (counted_predictions is empty; observed_before_prereg names what was seen of each).
